# truenas_init_script (Data Source)

Looks up exactly one existing `initshutdownscript` object by `id` or `query_filters`. Secrets are not exposed.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Identifier of the object to read.
- `query_filters` (String) Middleware query filters as JSON, e.g. `jsonencode([["path", "=", "/mnt/tank/x"]])`. Must match exactly one object.

### Read-Only

- `command` (String) Must be given if `type="COMMAND"`.
- `comment` (String) Optional comment describing the purpose of this script.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the init/shutdown script is enabled to execute.
- `script` (String) Must be given if `type="SCRIPT"`.
- `timeout` (Number) An integer time in seconds that the system should wait for the execution of the script/command.

A hard limit for a timeout is configured by the base OS, so when a script/command is set to execute on SHUTDOWN,     the hard limit configured by the base OS is changed adding the timeout specified by script/command so it can be     ensured that it executes as desired and is not interrupted by the base OS's limit.
- `type` (String) Type of init/shutdown script to execute.

* `COMMAND`: Execute a single command
* `SCRIPT`: Execute a script file
- `when` (String) * "PREINIT": Early in the boot process before all services have started.
* "POSTINIT": Late in the boot process when most services have started.
* "SHUTDOWN": On shutdown.
